entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx now that VS has much better support for it #50022
  • Dotnet CLI considers any file ending in "proj" as a project #50020

Closed

  • One letter 'd' argument is not working after upgrade to .NET 6 #23003
    8.0.4xx
  • Cannot control verbosity with `dotnet tool restore --verbosity` #27153
  • Task common files should support nullable enable #25920
  • .NET Tools work natively in arm64 environments and feel first-class on all platforms #29436
  • [Proposal] .NET Tools should default to running on the latest available Runtime #30336
  • Support for new Workload Set Versions #35455
  • .NET 8 RC2 does not honor ignore-failed-sources flag when running dotnet tool install #36473
  • Notification of newer workload versions available isn't displayed with versions installed through Visual Studio #40295
  • dotnet tool install error installing when a private feed is in nuget.config #24140
  • dotnet-tools.json: add path to project installed tool #37450
  • dotnet tool install failed with DirectoryNotFoundException #40039
  • Silent workload updates break builds #40222
  • Microsoft.NET.Sdk references deprecated package Microsoft.NETCore.Targets #42544
  • New `--os` argument for `dotnet restore` #37245
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 10.0.100-preview.7.25380.105, MAUI workload installation fails due to missing NuGet packages #50005
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 10.0.100-preview.7.25380.105 EXE, returning to manifest mode fails with missing package error #50006
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Add HTTP warnings to dotnet tool install scenarios #50027
  • Handle escaping of command-line arguments in dotnet test #50026
    Area-dotnet test
  • Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx format for .NET 10 #50023

Merged

  • Stop promoting nuget-client via sdk #50021
    Area-Infrastructure
  • add System.Net.Http.WasmEnableStreamingResponse to RuntimeHostConfigurationOption #50000
    arch-wasm

Updated

  • Implementing dotnet pack with nuspec files #49813
    Area-CLI
  • Cleanup DOTNET_ROOT logic for dotnet run #49913
  • [watch] Fix /bl option parsing, use it for build logging #50002
    Area-Watch
  • NET tool roll forward error experience #38210
    Area-Tools, Branch Lockdown, 10.0.1xx
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Use BuildManager.Build API and a custom msbuild logger to store props #49728
  • Unskip test cases #50010
